round_note: Label-free detector with the same ledger groups. Declared before any ledger result existed; see research-ledger.json for the caveat on how the features were chosen. Amended before any ledger backtest ran: an `exposure` group (other identities' logons on the identity's own computers over the last 3 days) was added to the combined candidates and as its own candidate, after checking that scenario 3's takeover records fall under the victim's account.
selection_rule: Highest mean timely incidents summed over folds, among candidates with mean admissions no greater than the ecod_up_top5 control and mean current-positive yield no lower; ties broken by yield.
